title: eSIM QR code activation fails
body:
eSIM activation fails when the QR code was already used, the handset is not eSIM-compatible or carrier-locked, or the phone has no internet during activation. Regenerate the eSIM profile, confirm device compatibility via the IMEI, and make sure the phone is connected to Wi-Fi while scanning the QR code.

  1. Confirm the handset supports eSIM and is not carrier-locked using its IMEI.
  2. Check that the QR code has not already been used and regenerate the eSIM profile if it has.
  3. Ask the customer to connect to Wi-Fi and scan the new QR code from Settings.
  4. Restart the phone after the profile downloads and confirm the line is active.
  5. If activation still fails, escalate to the eSIM provisioning team with the EID.

Check that the QR code has not already been used and regenerate the eSIM profile if it has.
Ask the customer to connect to Wi-Fi and scan the new QR code from Settings.
Restart the phone after the profile downloads and confirm the line is active.
If activation still fails, escalate to the eSIM provisioning team with the EID.

title: Roaming not working abroad or unexpected roaming charges
body:
Customers abroad who cannot use data or are billed roaming charges need the roaming add-on checked. Verify roaming is enabled on the line, that the destination is covered by the customer's roaming pass, and enable data roaming on the phone. Charges outside a pass are billed at standard roaming rates and can be disputed once for first-time travellers.

  1. Verify international roaming is enabled on the line and the destination is covered by a roaming pass.
  2. Ask the customer to enable data roaming on the handset and select the partner network manually.
  3. Check usage records to see whether charges were outside the roaming pass.
  4. Offer to activate a roaming pass for the rest of the trip.
  5. Offer a one-time goodwill credit for first-time roaming bill shock.
